content.user_title: Audit Web Quality with Measured Evidence
content.value_statement: Web quality problems span performance, accessibility, search visibility, and interaction behavior. This skill guides evidence-based reviews with browser measurements, source checks, prioritized fixes, and repeatable verification.
actual_capabilities: Guide live audits across performance, accessibility, SEO, best practices, and agentic browsing using available browser tools.
Route performance analysis to browser traces and distinguish laboratory observations from real-user Core Web Vitals.
Check local HTML for doctype, charset, viewport, language, title, image alternatives, and HTTP URL strings through the included script.
Inspect rendered semantics and interaction flows through accessibility snapshots and manual checks.
Organize findings by impact, evidence, confidence, recommended fixes, and verification status.
Recommend equivalent repeat measurements and affected manual flow checks after changes.
limitations: Live measurements require available browser or Lighthouse tooling; these tools are not bundled.
The Bash analyzer requires jq and uses text patterns rather than a rendered DOM or full HTML parser.
Automated checks do not establish complete accessibility compliance, security assurance, or improved search rankings.
Linked sibling guidance is outside the two-file package, and real-user performance validation requires field data.

use_cases.title: Prepare a release review
use_cases.description: Review representative pages and critical user flows, prioritize failures, and verify affected behavior before deployment.

use_cases.title: Assess accessibility and interaction
use_cases.description: Combine automated findings with keyboard navigation, focus, labels, and rendered semantic checks.

use_cases.title: Prioritize website improvements
use_cases.description: Compare technical SEO and performance evidence across important pages without treating scores as proof of business outcomes.

prompt_templates.title: Review one page
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit [URL] for web quality. Use available tools and separate measured findings from source hypotheses. List the most important fixes.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner review of a public page.

prompt_templates.title: Inspect local HTML
prompt_templates.prompt: Check HTML in [directory] with the included read-only analyzer. Summarize issues and warnings. Identify checks that need a live browser.
prompt_templates.scenario: Source review when a live page is unavailable.

prompt_templates.title: Audit a critical journey
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit [journey] on [URL] for mobile and desktop. Check accessibility, performance, SEO, and agentic browsing. Preserve authenticated state where possible.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate review of a stateful user flow.

prompt_templates.title: Verify a remediation cycle
prompt_templates.prompt: Establish a baseline for [URLs] under [conditions]. Prioritize evidence-backed fixes, implement approved changes, and repeat equivalent checks. Separate lab results from field validation.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced audit with changes and regression verification.

output_examples.input: Illustrative request: review a local HTML page without browser access.
output: Source finding: the page lacks a viewport declaration.
Source warning: an image has no alt attribute.
Recommended checks: inspect responsive layout and determine whether the image is informative or decorative.
Verification limit: rendered behavior and performance were not measured.

output_examples.input: Illustrative request: summarize an audit of a mobile navigation flow.
output: Evidence: keyboard testing found that the open menu does not show a visible focus indicator.
Priority: high because keyboard users cannot reliably locate the active control.
Recommendation: restore visible focus styling and test every menu action.
Verification: repeat the same flow after the change; screen reader validation remains pending.

best_practices: Define representative URLs, authenticated states, important journeys, and device conditions before collecting evidence.
Keep browser measurements, field data, source hypotheses, and manual observations clearly separated.
Repeat checks under equivalent conditions and record unresolved human or field validation.
anti_patterns: Treating a Lighthouse score or static source result as proof of overall quality.
Promising search ranking gains or AI visibility from technical audit results.
Comparing measurements across different conditions or ignoring state changes caused by navigation audits.

faq.question: Does this skill include Lighthouse or a browser?
faq.answer: No. It guides available browser and Lighthouse tools and includes a local HTML checking script.

faq.question: Can I use it without a live website?
faq.answer: Yes. Use source inspection or the included Bash script with jq. Runtime behavior and performance remain unverified.

faq.question: Does the local script change files or contact websites?
faq.answer: No. It reads the selected file or directory and reports results. HTTP strings are matched locally, not requested.

faq.question: Does it guarantee accessibility compliance?
faq.answer: No. Automated checks must be combined with keyboard, screen reader, and other human testing.

faq.question: How does it handle authenticated pages?
faq.answer: It recommends preserving important states and using snapshot audits when navigation reloads would disrupt the review.

faq.question: Can it prove better search rankings or AI visibility?
faq.answer: No. Technical SEO and agentic browsing findings are diagnostic signals, not guarantees of ranking, ingestion, or citation.
